app.name: GhanaWatch
app.tagline: Ghana's environmental changes, seen from space and shared with everyone

home.title: Ghana's monthly satellite report on its land and rivers
home.intro: Every month, GhanaWatch publishes a number for every district: the land newly mined for gold, seen from space and placed in its district, with the evidence behind it. Galamsey leads; rivers, forest reserves, fires and floods follow.
home.stale: Data is older than 48 hours. Satellite imagery or a provider may be delayed.
home.forResearchersBody: Every record you see on the map can be filtered and downloaded as CSV or GeoJSON, with its source, image date, confidence and licence. See how to read the map and how accurate it is.

report.title: Report what you see
report.intro: Photos from the ground help confirm or correct what satellites detect. Every report is checked automatically against the photo's own location, GhanaWatch's satellite record and other people's reports, and published as soon as something confirms it.
report.photoHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. If your camera saved where the photo was taken, that is used to check the report and then removed from the photo; it is never shown. Faces are blurred.
report.locationHelp: Use Near me, or find the place on the map and click it. You can drag the pin to adjust.
report.descriptionHelp: Up to 500 characters. Do not include names or details that identify people.
report.sent: Report sent. It is being checked now.
report.queued: You are offline. The report is saved and will be sent when you reconnect.
report.failed: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
report.consent: I confirm this report is accurate to the best of my knowledge and does not identify any person.
report.anonymous: You do not need an account and we never ask for your name. Faces in photos are blurred, location data is removed from your photo, phone numbers and e-mail addresses are removed from your text, and public pages show the place to about 100 m.
report.sentBody: It is checked automatically, usually within a minute, against your photo's location, the satellite record and other reports. Keep this link to follow what happens to it:
report.pinHint: Click the map to drop the pin, or drag the pin to adjust it.
report.pinAria: Map for choosing where you saw it
report.photoLocationUsed: Using the location saved in your photo (±{accuracy} m).
report.photoLocationUsedNoAccuracy: Using the location saved in your photo.
report.photoLocationDiffers: Your photo saved its own location, {distance} from the one above.
report.photoNoLocation: This photo has no saved location. For the quickest check, use Near me while you are at the place.

cases.pendingBody: Every report is checked automatically against the photo's own location, the satellite record and other people's reports, and published as soon as something confirms it. If nothing does yet, it is checked again with each new satellite pass for up to 30 days. Come back to this link later.
cases.rejectedBody: It did not pass the checks: for example, the photo was taken somewhere else or long ago, or it was already sent. Thank you for reporting; you can send another report at any time.
cases.needsInfoBody: A moderator could not confirm it from the photo. If you can, send a new report with a clearer photo.
cases.unverifiedTitle: This report could not be confirmed
cases.unverifiedBody: For 30 days nothing confirmed it: the photo had no location of its own, no satellite saw a matching change and nobody else reported the same. It stays on record but is not published. If it is still happening, send a new report from the place using Near me.

land.title: Check this land
land.intro: Drop a pin on a plot and see what public satellite data says about it since 2020: mining or clearing, forest loss, fires, nearby galamsey and forest reserves. For land buyers, farmers and cocoa buyers. It is not a land title search.
land.pickHelp: Click the map where the land is, or use your location. Switch to Satellite to find it by sight.
land.pinFirst: Drop a pin on the map first.
land.pdfHelp: One page with the pictures, every finding's source and date, and the limits. Takes up to a minute the first time.
land.changeRunning: Comparing satellite images of the plot from early 2020 with recent months. This can take up to a minute.
land.changeFailed: The satellite comparison could not be completed right now. The other findings below are complete.
land.limitsHeading: Read this before relying on it
land.limits: This summarises public satellite data. It is not a land title search, a survey or a legal finding. Small, very recent or cloud-hidden changes can be missed, and cleared land can be farming as well as mining. Check on the ground and with the Lands Commission before any decision.
land.eudrTitle: Cocoa farms and the EU deforestation rule
land.eudrBody: From 30 December 2026, cocoa sold into the EU must come from land that was not forest cleared after 31 December 2020. Pin your farm and the report shows forest on it at the end of 2020, in the EU's own map, and any tree loss since. Print the PDF for your buyer or cooperative. It is evidence, not a compliance decision; COCOBOD's traceability system still applies.
